continuum:collectorarn.description: Filters access by the ARNs of the collectors in an AssociateCollector or DisassociateCollector request

continuum:environmentarn.description: Filters access by the ARN of the environment that requests access to the data of a collector

continuum:repositoryname.description: Filters access by the repositories, as lowercase owner/repo values, that a CreateEnvironment or UpdateEnvironment request selects as sources

continuum:s3bucketname.description: Filters access by the name of the Amazon S3 bucket in a CreateIntegration request
